newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- Dutch trade dominated by small orders.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- Dutch trade dominated by small orders.

text.p: Trade on the Amsterdam European Options Exchange was dominated by many small orders, dealers said. The floor was quite busy, but the volume small.
Dealers said volume might pick up after Wall Street's opening.

The call/put ratio over the total market was near 1.045, remaining low compared to the last couple of weeks when there was a much bigger demand for calls. The call/put ratio of the top five stocks was below one, indicating a negative sentiment.
Dealers said the recent fall was a normal correction after an extended rise.
